steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Cough, cough... Contamination device... I should've known.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Fortunately, the FAC armor still has some Anti-Mania devices, I need to get out before the Hypercube storage runs out.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I have no idea where this car is going, or how much time I've just wasted. I need to hurry...
She struggles to move the unconscious Commander-in-Chief, but quickly discovers a chilling device on the man.
At this moment, the sound of electricity crackling comes from the other end of the darkness.
A familiar voice comes from the other end of the walkie-talkie.
